_mock: Hand-written mock report. Not real research.
summary: Houston is the lowest-cost option for 100 MW by 2029. Cheap power and a strong trades workforce outweigh summer water stress and a crowded pipeline of planned projects.

sections.finding: Industrial power is cheap; typical interconnection wait is about 2.5 years.
Medium-high summer water stress; dry cooling is a hedge.
Industrial land east of the city is plentiful and mostly above flood terrain.
Nine projects already planned in the region; crowding may raise power prices.
